title: How to Lose a Popularity Contest
overview: A rebellious student and a perfectionist overachiever form an unlikely alliance in their race for student body president, discovering unexpected feelings along the way.

title: WWE SummerSlam 2026: Saturday
overview: The 2026 SummerSlam, also promoted as SummerSlam: Minnesota, is a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It is the 39th annual SummerSlam and took place as a two-night event on August 1st and 2nd at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

title: Anemoia
overview: Marcos has been living most of his life on autopilot, as a spectator, daydreaming of something better than his current situation, until the father who abandoned him as a child knocks on his door.

title: Boy Trouble
overview: When Britney’s friends suspect her boyfriend might be a serial killer, she laughs it off—until she can’t.

title: Your Sky: Hare Nochi Koi
overview: Hinata, a kind-hearted, innocent, and positive guy, and Sora, a tsundere senior who’s a campus celebrity and feared as the “Tyrant Prince.” They’re supposed to be fake lovers… but is this real love?! The fates of these two, who were never meant to cross paths, take a dramatic turn after a spur-of-the-moment “lie.”

title: Saliva Agridoce
overview: After years of trying to leave behind the traumas that marked their lives, a couple decides to start over in an old house far from the city. Boundaries between memory, guilt, and the supernatural begin to disappear.

title: The Almajiri
overview: In the ancient city of Kano, a gifted almajiri defies poverty and dogma in pursuit of education, risking everything to become a tech engineer. Raised on scripture and survival, Rabiu's extraordinary mind cannot stay hidden. When a teacher sees his genius and fights for his future, he must choose between the only world he knows and the one he was born to build.

title: Jumpin' Dublin
overview: A film about the elite set attracted to all things equestrian in Ireland which attracts luminaries such as Maeve Binchy, Mick and Bianca Jagger, Lady Iveagh, Garech Browne and Lady Zara Jellicoe at a Hunt Ball and at a dinner in Luggala Estate.

title: Killer Clown
overview: Decades after witnessing her mother’s brutal murder at the hands of the “Killer Clown,” Elizabeth Helmer (Sara Paxton) remains haunted by the crime that shattered her childhood. When she begins investigating the long-unsolved cold case, Elizabeth becomes the target of a terrifying copycat stalker, forcing her to confront painful memories she has spent a lifetime trying to escape. As she searches for answers alongside her father Reed (David Cubitt) and husband Dan (Hamza Haq), Elizabeth uncovers a tangled web of family betrayal and long-buried secrets.  As she closes in on the truth, Elizabeth must separate fact from manipulation and fight to survive before history repeats itself.

title: AAA Verano de Escándalo 2026 - Week 2
overview: Week 2 of AAA Verano de Escándalo from Aguascalientes features a AAA World Cruiserweight Championship match as Rey Fenix clashes against Mini Vikingo. Plus, La Parka, Mecha Wolf, and Lince Dorado battle for a spot at Triplemanía and the opportunity to challenge for the AAA Latin American Championship. Also, Galeno teams up with Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. to take on Drago and Dinámico.
cast: El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr.

title: The Boy
overview: A transgender woman searches a Cornish coastal town for a lost boy but quickly finds herself in a race against the Law.

title: Toast to Italy
overview: Jenny travels to Italy for a special bottle of wine for her sister's wedding. She meets Arrigo, also looking for the famous "Love Wine" and together their search leads to a love of their own.

title: WWE SummerSlam 2026: Sunday
overview: The 2026 SummerSlam, also promoted as SummerSlam: Minnesota, is a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It is the 39th annual SummerSlam and took place as a two-night event on August 1st and 2nd at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

title: The Lift
overview: The world's first film shot entirely inside an elevator, from the brilliant mind of Sexocracy author Luca Redavid. Bologna, August 2, 1980. A terrifying roar shakes the central station, while six strangers remain trapped in a cabin just steps from hell. Isolated from the world in a claustrophobic space of just a few square meters, tensions rise to the limit as air runs out and help fails to arrive...

title: Hard Break
overview: In a near-future world where heartbreak has become weaponized and emotional immunity is just a pill away, a teenage girl grapples with whether to erase her pain or hold on to the feelings that make her human.

title: Décima
overview: In 1980s Puerto Rico, a grieving man is torn between escaping with his pregnant wife or joining his radicalized younger brother in a dangerous fight for justice, as the death of their brother threatens to tear their family and community apart.

title: Ice Cream Man
overview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

title: Storm on Sesame Street
overview: As a big storm approaches, Elmo and friends work together to get ready. After it passes, Sesame Street looks different — and everyone pitches in to help.

title: Turtle Rock
overview: A teenage girl named Turtle must overcome her stage fright to fight against dangerous musical monsters with the power of rock ‘n’ roll.

title: Angel Dark
overview: Two best friends, Lilith and Miley, head to a carnival for a nostalgic night of fun, laughter, and memories. Amid the bright lights and lively music, an old flame from Lilith’s past unexpectedly appears, hoping to reconnect and rekindle what they once had.

title: Before Never
overview: When Wendy Darling escapes an attempted abduction, her family employs James and Smee to identify the attacker with the help of the only eyewitness: Peter Pan.

title: Our Town
overview: Grover's Corners is a quiet little town, full of ordinary folk, living everyday lives. They work, they laugh, they sing, they fall in love and raise their children and grow old. But within those moments of ordinary, everyday life, there are truths that reach out to us all. And a passionate demand to cherish every moment, right now, while we still can. (A joint Welsh National Theatre and Rose Theatre production, filmed at the Rose Theatre in Kingston, London on 19 March 2026.)

title: The Balloon is a Life Never Celebrated
overview: Aji, an orphaned boy, watches as other children celebrate their birthdays with balloons and the cheerful song “Happy Birthday.” The simple sight awakens a longing to experience the same joy for himself. Using money meant for his daily necessities, Aji secretly buys a balloon. But before he can celebrate his birthday, the balloon deflates. While searching for a replacement, Aji discovers an unfamiliar object that resembles a balloon. Unaware of its true purpose, he blows it up and uses it to celebrate his birthday alone.

title: RAGEBAIT
overview: On Halloween night, a socially parasitic live streamer becomes the target of a malevolent entity after a mysterious viewer curses his stream and forces him to watch a collection of cursed videos from missing content creators.

title: Trigger Happy
overview: A neon action-thriller about influencers fighting to the death at a live-streamed, lethal laser-tag match, exploring competition, revenge, and weaponized performance.

title: Inside the Trustor Scandal
overview: For the first time since 1997, Joachim Posener finally emerges from hiding and allows himself to be interviewed about his life and the Trustor affair. Twenty-seven years ago, he disappeared without a trace, and ever since, he has been on the international most wanted list. Now, Karin af Klintberg searches for him to find out how he lives and where he's been hiding all these years. But perhaps above all, to uncover what everyone is wondering: Was he guilty? Through new and opposing testimonies from never-before-heard voices, Karin simultaneously continues the search for the truth about the coup. How could five people swindle 600 million kr and still go free? And where did the money actually go?

title: The Painting
overview: A young woman lives alone in a cabin and in the middle of the woods she's used to being alone, but slowly she realizes she is being watched.

title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
overview: In a bold 28-day experiment, comedian Mo Gilligan tours the UK and US on a fried chicken diet to uncover the impact of the craving — and industry behind it.

title: Rosario
overview: When Beth and Ave's mother died, a relative unknowingly put a rosary in her mother’s hand. According to superstitious belief, the rosary needs to be cut before burying the corpse, but they forgot to do so. Now, the curse of death follows Beth's family one by one. Desperate to end the curse, Beth must uncover the truth and find a way to break it before death consumes them too.

title: Baggage Claim
overview: Upon learning of their mother's untimely death, lone-stoner Abby and type-A brother Ben must embark on a body identification road trip home to claim her corpse - along with their own personal baggage.

title: Rodeo
overview: Two men meet one night to engage in a radical and mysterious act of intimacy.

title: Teenieping: Legend of the Whale Heartstone
overview: Romi has been living happily ever since Heartsping became her best friend. But she and her mother, Belita, keep clashing over what Romi wants to do versus what she's told she must do... Then one day, an event that shakes the entire sea sweeps her mother away without a trace. Romi loses her mother without ever getting to say sorry — without one last hug. Standing before the sea for the very first time, she finds the courage to act, together with her best friend Heartsping, the sea boy Kite, and three Teeniepings... Together, they must face a dazzling underwater city and colossal creatures of the deep. And at last, Romi comes face to face with a secret her mother had never once told her.

title: LILITH
overview: SHE LEFT ONE MORNING AND NEVER ARRIVED—NOW SOMETHING’S HOME, AND IT ISN’T ALIVE.

title: Later.
overview: The invisible half of his brother's rap act, a 17-year-old beatmaker spends the night of the biggest show running errands. He steals an hour for his own music and gets caught for the one thing he did for himself.

title: AGAIN
overview: After having her proverbial third eye opened by the strange man who calls himself The Great Opticisioner, Evie Narmer is able to see directly into her past lives. Proving two things: reincarnation is real, but also that her past lives were awful. One of them in particular depicts an awful cult that she thus writes a deep and detailed novel on. Unexpectedly, the last surviving original member catches wind of this novel, and reignites the flame that cult once had. Now, that old man and Evie are at odds. What will happen next? Watch and find out.

title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
overview: After years of slapdash sequels, the Camp Miasma franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original’s star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.

title: Rage of Stars
overview: A story about a woman from the International Special Forces Unit, who has a premonition about the impending end of humanity.

title: Super Troopers 3
overview: When Farva’s wildly over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny’s sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny’s schemes to break up the relationship, while trying to crack a pernicious new drug ring  — all to save the day and maybe the wedding itself.

title: One Night Only
overview: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

title: The Last House
overview: A family suddenly sealed inside their home must work together to survive against dwindling resources and the ominous threat keeping them trapped.

title: DC
overview: Rebel Devadas joins forces with Chandra in a dangerous world where passion and peril collide. Their turbulent alliance demands bloodshed and tests loyalties as survival becomes the ultimate stake in their fight.

title: Nimrods
overview: Three friends journey from Kansas City to Los Angeles, mistakenly believing that their band is opening for Green Day on New Year’s Eve.

title: Feed
overview: Five social media influencers spend a weekend at a forest retreat but inadvertently awaken and confront the world's first vampire.

title: Cannelloni
overview: Inspired by true events, this is a nocturnal thriller that follows the 2015 kidnapping of Chichita—mother of writer Hernán Casciari—by Daniel Olesnik. Olesnik seeks to settle a blood debt: to avenge a prank played by Hernán and his friend Chiri back in 1987, which drove his own mother to suicide. It is an inescapable, suffocating, and deadly spiral of vengeance that unfolds over the course of a single night.

title: Everytime
overview: A tragedy brings a mother, daughter, and teenage boy together. Struggling with blame and forgiveness, the unlikely trio take a trip to Tenerife  for a family holiday that never happened. Under the glow of the sun,  past and present quietly start to overlap.

title: The Last Warrior: Kolobok
overview: Kolobok decides to change his fate and unwittingly becomes the partner of the humble baker Tikhon.

title: A Story Carved on a Tree
overview: When 13-year-old Nisha insults the powerful village Sarpanch, she’s chased by his vengeful son from bus stop to home. Scared and tired, she starts having nightmares about a ghostly woman. But soon, Nisha learns the ghost is actually her grandmother, who had once stood up to the same injustice.Inspired by her, Nisha finds the strength to stand her ground and reclaim her dignity.

title: Korean Kanakaraju
overview: Possessed by a Korean spirit, Kanakaraju must navigate his new supernatural identity to protect his family and solve the spirit's murder.

title: Vietslam: Squashing the Cultural Gap
overview: This documentary follows the birth of Vietnam's indie professional wrestling scene- from cramped gyms to a breakout showcase- capturing the hustle, humor, and heart it takes to win over skeptics and build a community one suplex at a time.

title: Tiket Sehala
overview: Alif, Putri and Taqy, three Malaysians trapped in a human trafficking syndicate in South Korea, show the dark reality of labor exploitation and the struggle to return home.

title: MAJU (Jejak Pahit si Kembang Gula)
overview: Mr. Wira is a teacher and scout leader for a group of his students. They plan to survey the location of the Scout Jamboree in Segosari village. Bagas, a big fan of the popular candy variety at that time, did not join his teacher and friends to visit the Village Head's house. Bagas was feeling unwell and just waited in the car. Upon returning from the Village Head's house, Bagas disappeared. The presence of Adit, a village boy who often gets bullied by other children, becomes an important key to finding Bagas.

title: Storm Bird
overview: A celebrated composer facing death, his working-class neighbour facing jail, and a sharp New York writer form an unlikely alliance over one charged weekend in Far North Queensland.

title: ORPHIA
overview: A band defined by fame and excess reunites for a landmark concert. As old wounds resurface, Ravi, Ícaro, Anastasia, Theo, and Eva are forced to confront the consequences of their choices, the weight of guilt, and the boundaries between affection, dependency, and redemption. Amidst the chaos, music remains the only place where it is still possible to exist.

title: Ohh My Dog
overview: In Assam, 14-year-old Apu embarks on a desperate quest to rescue his beloved dog, Momo, after he is kidnapped. Elsewhere, in Bihar, a devoted dog named Oscar sets out on a perilous journey to find his kidnapped owner, a 15-year-old child labourer. As their journeys unfold, it becomes clear that the two kidnappings may be connected to a larger, sinister plan.

title: The Angel Maker
overview: Tells the story of the Swiss religious community of Methernitha, which still exists today, its founder Paul Baumann – the inventor of a mysterious energy machine – and the young women who brought him down on charges of child abuse.

title: Manhunt
overview: Inspired by the real 2019 Northern British Columbia manhunt when two teenage boys from Vancouver Island murdered three strangers and fled north through ghost towns and endless forest. Their flight, live-tracked across social media and news feeds, unfolded like a fever dream of the digital age: an openworld simulation of fear and fascination. Weeks later, their bodies were found by a river, the chase ending as abruptly as it began.

title: Tony
overview: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

title: Hanuman Ansh
overview: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.

title: THE RIBBON HERO
overview: When the monstrous Nergal devastates her kingdom, Princess Sapphire reawakens as the Ribbon Hero and fights to save her new home from the same dark fate.

title: G.D.N
overview: G.D. Naidu overcomes challenges and defies a repressive colonial regime to become one of India's greatest innovators.

title: Deathwoods
overview: A weekend of camping intended to break Scott out of his post breakup depression, quickly turns  into a weekend of bloodshed, as his friends are picked off one by one by the urban legend that haunts the  woods surrounding the small town of Old Hickory, Tennessee.

title: Thudakkam
overview: When danger strikes, a young woman fights to survive through courage and determination.

title: Blue Lock
overview: A secret training program is established by the Japan Football Union to scout the world’s greatest striker after several years of defeat for the national team. Three hundred high school players gather at a remote facility to compete in ruthless trials where only one will emerge as the world’s greatest and most egoistic striker. The price of failure is absolute: those eliminated are permanently banned from ever joining the National Team.

title: Late Fame
overview: At the very end of the 1970’s, post office worker Ed Saxberger wrote a book of poetry that nobody cared about. After an eager and flattering fan appears on his doorstep, Saxberger is beckoned into a coterie of young admirers who anoint him a rediscovered genius. The group of downtown bohemians is led by their “tragic heroine,” Gloria. Intoxicated by the attention, and Gloria’s alluring presence, Saxberger gradually reckons with the authenticity of his newfound poetic circle.

title: Ang Modista
overview: A provocative story about a seamstress who uses her body to attract more customers, until the arrival of one man that changes her life forever.

title: Olmo
overview: When Olmo gets invited to a party by his beautiful neighbor, he will do whatever he can to meet up with her, embarking on a night of laughs and chaos.

title: Warrior
overview: Jenny's invisible chronic illness has negatively impacted her life for almost a decade. As her next doctor's appointment draws near, painful memories resurface, and the depth of the injustice she has endured becomes clear.

title: Bottled Up
overview: Simon decides to declare his love to his boss, Melanie, by hosting a romantic dinner at his mom's house. Over the course of the night, a number of unexpected guests show up leading to an onslaught of confusion.

title: Total Coverage
overview: A compilation of the various angles shot to cover the creation of wet and messy fetish content.

title: Cookie Queens
overview: A celebration of girlhood and the complexities that come with it, Cookie Queens is a coming-of-age story about the joys, pressures, and tensions woven into one of America’s most cherished rituals: Girl Scout Cookie season.

title: Attack of the Killer Tomatoes: Organic Intelligence
overview: "Jurassic Park" meets "Dr. Strangelove". It's a reprise and fifth feature spin of the 1978 Cult Classic "Attack of the Killer Tomatoes," the franchise that went from 80s midnight screenings to help launch the Fox Children's TV Network.

title: The Blood Countess
overview: The Blood Countess and her maid embark on a quest for the red elixir of life and a book that threatens the vampire realm. Hot on their heels are a police inspector, two vampirologists, a vegetarian nephew and his therapist.

title: 2 Valid IDs
overview: A poor farmer, unable to claim a remittance because she lacks the required two valid IDs, finds herself in a situation that challenges her character, beliefs, and morality.

title: Photographer
overview: Photographer follows Veera, a troubled and obsessive photographer determined to prove his worth in a world that has long dismissed him. Driven by ambition and haunted by a painful past, he ventures deep into Mathikettan Solai, a mysterious reserve forest, to capture a rare and elusive natural phenomenon that could change his life forever.

title: National Sport
overview: As his girlfriend prepares to leave for Australia, a professional queuer who drifts through life without urgency finds it easier to share his fears with strangers in line than confront the end of his relationship, spending his final days suspended between waiting, regret, and the comfort of the present moment.

title: Reform
overview: A man spirals within a never-ending work day and is visited by another being.

title: The Blessing
overview: Several people have barricaded themselves inside a bar. The music must never stop, otherwise something terrible could happen.

title: Phillip Philadelphia
overview: British screenwriter Phillip Philadelphia conducts a retiring life of fantasy, delusion and tawdry eroticism from a Gold Coast motel; meanwhile the ghosts of love and past glory begin to erode his web of reverie.

title: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East
overview: Seeking a fresh start, chef Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to support his family and repay his debts. Alongside restaurant manager Ma Junsheng, he transforms the struggling Dragon Restaurant into a thriving business. But when war engulfs the city, their hard-won success is shattered and the restaurant becomes a refuge for those caught in the conflict. As danger closes in, Xu Fu must risk everything to protect his newfound community and preserve a small beacon of hope amid the devastation.

title: Absolutely Devoted to You
overview: An ambitious TV producer devises a brilliant plan to reunite a 90's boy band for an annual summer beach bash, but her idea is derailed when she falls for the band's reluctant lead singer.

title: Demon Agent
overview: The fantastical and magnificent city of Chang'an, a city woven with gears and mechanisms, is home to both humans and demons living side by side beneath its upturned eaves. Di Shao, a genius young man aspiring to become "Chang'an's Number One Detective," possesses exceptional crime-solving skills and a sharp tongue; while Asa, a rookie wolf demon constable, is formidable in martial arts yet kind-hearted. A bizarre murder case forces these two adversaries to team up, embarking on a hilarious and bickering detective journey. As clues point to the heart of the city, can this unreliable duo protect the joyful daily life of this fantastical city? And what earth-shattering secret lies hidden behind the bustling and prosperous Chang'an?

title: Tides
overview: A struggling musician couple at the Kenyan coast must navigate mounting financial pressures and their daughter's serious illness, testing the limits of their love, resilience and sacrifice.

title: Her Ciro
overview: A radio tower operator calls his wife in wartime.

title: She Stole My Son's Heart
overview: After her last heart transplant fails, Maria is in desperate need of a new heart. Fearing it could give out at any moment, she turns down her boyfriend’s proposal and heads out for a walk — only to mysteriously disappear. As the search intensifies, homicide and missing persons detective Vicky and her rookie partner are assigned to the case. With Maria's time running out, it becomes a race to uncover the truth behind Maria's disappearance before her failing heart gives out.

title: Singularity
overview: 15,000 years before our era, during the Pleistocene, just before the great ice age, three saber-toothed tigers are born in a cave. One of them is markedly different from the others.

title: PROXY
overview: Clyde and his Al girlfriend, Alora, excitedly try a new service that installs Alora into a real, live, human body. But the dream becomes a nightmare when they find out the body proxies are not sourced as advertised. Now Alora is faced with a devastating choice.

title: Private Property
overview: Two outsiders – Maya, a Nepali immigrant working overnight to build a future, and Danny, an unhoused Black veteran searching for warmth and shelter – clash over one small space. Maya reaches for the law, then a gun, to belong.

title: Voltei na Foto
overview: Leonardo is a man frustrated with his life until, unexpectedly, he is transported back to 1986. In the past, he encounters his younger self and attempts to change his own future.

title: Three Housewives and a Body
overview: Lorelai loves living in her neighborhood, right next to best friends Jackie and Ella. During girl's night at Jackie's house a home invasion goes terribly wrong when the three women accidentally kill a man.

title: Agbogbloshie
overview: The world replaced six thousand phones this morning. All of them are burning in Agbogbloshie, in the heart of Accra, where six thousand people make a living stripping copper from what you replaced. They breathe air five times more polluted than what the WHO considers safe. No one keeps track of what they die from. He lives there. And while everyone else scavenges for weight, he searches for the part that still works. With a washing machine motor, laptop batteries, and spliced wires, he raises a streetlight in the middle of the alley where he lives. That night, for the first time in twenty-two years, the street had light. That's why they found him. Fiction set in a place that exists.

title: Monkey Drum
overview: a folk nightmare

title: Her Silence
overview: An international student hosts her visiting parents in her Sydney flat, and spends two fraught days wrestling with her mother’s unspoken apprehensions about the life her daughter has chosen to build in Australia.

title: Dementium
overview: Wyatt Bailey retreats to a secluded cabin to solve his mother’s murder. After taking DMT to confront his dead father, he’s torn between visions of his ex-girlfriend offering hope and a witch urging destruction in a battle for his soul.

title: Daylight
overview: An isolated man, living in a new city, resorts to a hook up site in a desperate attempt to make a human connection.

title: Inferno
overview: Twenty years after a mysterious energy-gathering event, Dante remains haunted by what he witnessed that night. Withdrawn and unstable, he can no longer distinguish memory from hallucination. As his children investigate the tragedy that fractured their family, they uncover a past shaped by suppressed memories, guilt, and unresolved consequences. Meanwhile, Dante is pursued by Virgil, a spectral presence who acts as both guide and tormentor. Through a series of psychological trials, Virgil forces him to confront his distorted recollections, moral failures, and the truth of what happened in 2022. As past and present collide, Dante and his children must face their conflicting versions of the truth—and discover whether understanding it will bring forgiveness and redemption or cost them their sanity.

title: Confessions of a Shaman
overview: A man who decides to inherit the art of shamanism to exact personal revenge, leading to a series of terrifying events that change his life forever.

title: Maws
overview: A group of criminals known as The Hanover Gang rob and murder a rival gang. They hit the road and end up in a small seaside town called Luna Pier where they fall prey to a horrifying half-man, half-shark Nazi experiment.

title: Shackled
overview: In a dystopian future where the parole system has been replaced with R.A.P.P. - the Recidivism Accountability Partnership Program - a white collar ex-con must take drastic measures to ensure his survival when he's paired with a sociopathic gangster with terminal cancer. One wrong move by either of them could mean the summary execution of them both, via the explosive charges surgically implanted in their hearts as a condition of their release.

title: Exiles of Earth
overview: Five stories follow humanity beyond Earth, where explorers and survivors face alien worlds, impossible choices and the struggle to find a new place to call home.

title: What I'd Do for Love
overview: Greer Patterson's happy marriage falls apart when she discovers her husband's infidelity. After exacting bitter revenge, she's back on the market looking for love, and anyone standing in her way will see just how far she'll go. Based on the novel by K. F. Johnson.

title: Cheesecake
overview: A husband sets out to buy cheesecake for his pregnant wife, only to be swallowed by city chaos as she goes into labor alone.

title: The End of Oak Street
overview: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

title: Nando Between Two Worlds - A Sintonia Film
overview: Caught between family life and his obligations to the criminal underworld, Nando faces an impossible choice about where his true loyalties lie.

title: Sunny Dancer
overview: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.

title: OK! Madam: Bon Voyage
overview: Six years after the Hawaii airplane hijacking, Mi-yeong finds herself struggling with her rebellious teenage daughter, Nari, and her unemployed husband, Seok-hwan. When Hyun-min, a flight attendant she met during the hijacking, invites her family to his wedding aboard a luxury cruise ship, Mi-yeong eagerly proposes a family holiday. Met with indifference from her husband and daughter, she decides to embark alone, joining Hyun-min's family and Ji-hoon, a charming magician. However, on the eve of the wedding, the celebration turns deadly when armed assailants seize the ship. After Seok-hwan and Nari are kidnapped and brought aboard, Mi-yeong discovers that she is the target of a much larger plot.

title: Mom Died
overview: Eight siblings just found out that their granddad died. A broken game of telephone happens, and then they all fight.

title: Sad Girlz
overview: La Maestra and Paula are the best swimmers in their team and best friends, until an incident at a party changes everything. La Maestra, intense and unstoppable, realises that something in her best friend has changed, making her sad. When the truth comes to light, the two are faced with an impossible decision: Paula wants to keep quiet about it, while La Maestra wants revenge. Their friendship, previously unbreakable, will be put to the test as never before.

title: Katseye: Wild Hearts
overview: A celebration to the group's new era and the fans who made it possible. Features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, Eyekons fan videos, and intimate interviews with the members.

title: Fast
overview: For Sterling, a sort of present-day Alice, the graveyard Lotus she redeems becomes a totem, a saturated phenomenon permitting her to move freely in time on a phantom road. It is a sort of Ford but never a DeLorean. A Southern woman with a fair deal of historical baggage and deep secrets, Sterling journeys back to her rural home, the Lotus takes her through the shadow of the valley into the adjoining worlds of the living and the dead. Desiring to become an F1 driver, Sterling must go fast/hard, against/through all tunnels imagined or concrete.

title: Senior Moments
overview: These three characters’ stories mirror the real-life struggles faced by many senior citizens, reminding us that, despite differences in background or circumstances, the challenges of aging are universal. Through these emotional narratives, Senior Moments aims to foster empathy and a deeper understanding of the elderly, whose needs and experiences are often overlooked in today’s fast-paced world.

title: Pace
overview: After serving a prison sentence, 40-year old Malcolm is intent on rebuilding his life. He looks for purpose in his late brother’s passion for running and trains to run a full marathon. Confronted with unresolved family expectations, a judgemental society and destructive self-loathing, can Malcolm keep pace, or will he succumb to the unrelenting tempo of society?

title: ADEM
overview: Haunted by someone else's memories a construction worker in Germany, searches for a way to send them back to Kosovo.

title: The Rivals of Amziah King
overview: Deep within the backwoods of rural Oklahoma, charismatic and musically gifted Amziah King herds a bluegrass-playing band of misfits while overseeing the premier honey-making operation in town. But the honey game is ruthless, and Amziah's rivals threaten to destroy everything he's built.

title: Camp Rock 3
overview: When pop group Connect 3 returns to Camp Rock to search for an opening act for their reunion tour, rising tensions and fierce competition among campers test old friendships and spark unexpected romances.

title: Don't Say Good Luck

A film type that hit its stride in the 1970's with hard hitting character studies such as WELCOME HOME, SOLDIERS BOYS (1971), THE NO MERCY MAN (1973) and ROLLING THUNDER (1977).

title: Of Womb
overview: Evading the hard truth of their religious matriarch’s death, three sisters gestate dark ecstasies of faith and folk horror. Blessed be Mother.

This film is fictional.

overview: At a party, Ana (30) runs into Dida (60), someone from her past. Ana’s desire to talk about "what happened" clashes with Dida’s refusal, escalating the conflict between them until it spirals out of control.

overview: On a quiet night, Sarah Mitchell, played by Karen Abercrombie, enters a dark church ready to end her life. Inside, Pastor David Reynolds, played by William L. Johnson faces his own loss of faith. Together, they confront hope.

overview: Christin, a successful district judge, had long since given up on love, until a hot-air-balloon pilot named Max enters her life. What begins as a fleeting encounter develops into a tender, surprising connection: Christin has chosen to live alone, in the reliable company of her chatbot Hermann, but now Max is turning her structured world upside down. Although the single father is the same age as Christin’s daughter Miriam, he doesn’t fall in love with her—he falls in love with Christin.

title: The Ferry Man: Butterfly Dream
overview: The tranquility of a remote mountain village was suddenly shattered when children began to disappear one by one. The villagers blamed the mysterious Mountain God for the children's disappearances.

title: Nihilo
overview: A woman carrying a hammer stumbles upon a mysterious door in the middle of nowhere. Now she must find a way to open it or live with the uncertainty of what might lie on the other side.

title: Moon River
overview: In the Amazon, Fábio and Igor experience a territory of discovery during their youth. This journey is interrupted by the departure of Fábio to another city. Twenty years later they meet again and, between memories and silences, they realize that they no longer remember the territory they once lived, only the fragmented and constantly shifting sentimental map, like the waters of the Benfica River.

title: The Babysitter’s Double Life
overview: A College Student begins an affair with a wealthy man who inspires her to create a babysitting-adjacent service for lonely, divorced fathers. However, things soon get dangerous as the operation grows into a full prostitution ring under her name.

title: Die Otissee
overview: The extraordinary journey of Otis Seuss.

title: Jwala
overview: A kidnapping reignites a decades-old blood feud, forcing a retired underworld figure and the men seeking vengeance against him into a brutal collision where no one is truly innocent.

title: Habsburg gegen Hohenzollern - Die Schlacht bei Königgrätz
Cadencia
overview: On the night her single mother is appointed as the first female concertmaster in the institution's history, nine-year-old Lola wanders the orchestra halls alone on her birthday, until an impulsive act exposes the distance between them.

title: Алоха!
overview: Eduard is a lonely, terminally ill man in the final stages of cirrhosis. His life changes dramatically when he meets a delivery robot named Aloha. This chance night, full of sadness and unexpected friendship, becomes Eduard's final journey into himself, toward forgiveness and reconciliation with those he lost.

title: Psyche
overview: The psychotherapist faces a personal crisis due to his involvement in the relationship with the client.

title: Love?
overview: A documentary about love. Filmed in Sicily, Italy. Filmmaker Boston B. interviews three people from around the world, Mexico, Ireland, and Italy, to see where they stand with love and how it affects them, from the magical to the grounded. He asks three questions: do you believe in true love, love at first sight, and the idea of "the one".

title: Keep Fit!
overview: An awkward and intrusive teenager armed with reports, presentations, and practical exercises literally pulls the teacher out of the noose—first with his tediousness, then with his absurdly persistent determination. Gradually, a strange game develops between them: from passing requirements and “fun starts” to an unexpected friendly closeness that temporarily restores both of their taste for life.

title: Blohaj
overview: 20 years ago, corporations erased the sea from all maps and sealed off the cities. A young architect steals crypto to survive - and discovers the sea is ten minutes away, past a forgotten border.

title: Дороги судоку
overview: One morning, Yana discovers that her domineering grandmother has transferred money to scammers and a colleague has framed her in front of her boss. To make matters worse, her grandmother continues to trust the scammers more than her own granddaughter. In a single day, Yana must find a way to save her job and her sense of self without destroying her relationship with her grandmother.

title: Only Bears
overview: Over the course of one wildly unpredictable day, two married bears attempt to rekindle their intimacy—but between traffic, screenings, queer social chaos, and a stranger handing them gently used pizza, life keeps acting like the pushy “third” in their relationship

title: Ночёвка
overview: Two elderly friends plan their own funerals in an attempt to conquer their fear of death, but instead find themselves feeling alive again.

title: Solus
overview: When unknown entities descend upon Earth, a recluse must navigate the consequences of their choices and society's fall.

title: TNA Lockdown 2026
overview: The 2026 Lockdown is an upcoming professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA). It will take place on Sunday, August 23, 2026, at Credit Union 1 Arena in Chicago, Illinois, United States. It will be the 13th event under the Lockdown chronology. This event will be the first Lockdown since 2016 and the first to be held as a pay-per-view event since 2014. The event's central theme is that the entire card is contested inside a steel cage. Beyond standard cage matches, the event frequently features specialized variations, most notably the signature Lethal Lockdown match.

title: The Headliner
overview: The Headliner is a multi-generational musical drama that explores the evolution, exploitation, and enduring spirit of hip-hop culture. The film follows a reclusive, legendary producer from the genre's "golden era" who is forced out of retirement to collaborate with a fiercely talented but unguided modern street rapper. As they clash over the soul of their music, they must unite to fight corporate greed and protect the artistic integrity of the culture.

title: Sandy
overview: As her childhood best friend prepares to depart for the US, a college student navigates her academic pursuits, strained family relationships, and a growing dread of the inevitable goodbye. ‘Sandy’ is a film about grief, memory, and how sometimes life forces you to bend into uncomfortable shapes as you go through it. Entirely self-funded and shot over two years in Davao City and Panabo City, it’s a love letter to the places and people we lose...or that lose us.

title: Butthole Surfers: The Hole Truth and Nothing Butt
overview: Follows the story of the groundbreaking Texas-based art-punk band founded by frontman Gibby Haynes and guitarist Paul Leary.

title: Vera
overview: A pregnant woman flees a violent past and takes refuge on the coast of Santa Fe, where she struggles to overcome the challenges of nature and existence itself.

title: 2 Big to Rig
overview: Captured live over the course of GHOST’s two sold-out shows in Mexico City last year, 2 BIG TO RIG is the definitive document of the band's unforgettable SKELETOUR WORLD TOUR, presented in IMAX® in select locations.  Featuring the only pro-shot footage of Papa V Perpetua and his band of Nameless Ghouls from the phone-free SKELETOUR, 2 BIG TO RIG immerses the audience in the GHOST live ritual, including exclusive behind-the-scenes and backstage access.

title: Jakob & Anxiety
overview: Jacob, aged 22, navigates his way through everyday situations, constantly accompanied by Anxiety, an intrusive and manipulative presence that only he can see.  When Jacob is reunited with Mille, a girl from his past, he is forced to confront the voice that has controlled his life.  In a surreal inner journey where fantasy and reality merge, Jacob learns that anxiety cannot be eradicated—but it can be faced, named and lived with. The film blends realism, humour and visual metaphor to explore vulnerability, mental health and the courage it takes to let someone see who you really are.

title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
overview: After delivering one of the greatest performances in Rose Bowl history, Texas Longhorns legend Vince Young was the NFL's next big thing, and for a while, he was. But a career riddled by injuries, conflict and sudden loss tells a far more complicated story than the highlight reels ever showed.

title: Stamptown
overview: Blending the wild worlds of circus and comedy, anarchic acts collide for this raunchy and explicit variety show - clothing not guaranteed.

title: Dolly Parton: An American Original – Special Edition of 20/20
overview: Celebrating Dolly Parton's life, music and legacy -- featuring never-before-seen interviews with Dolly herself, unforgettable interviews with Robin Roberts and Barbara Walters, and reflections from those who knew her best.

title: Desert Fiends 2
overview: A group of elite bounty hunters are on the trail to track down and kill The Desert Fiends. Meanwhile, a TikTok style influencer has come into town to have a meet up while the Desert Fiends are heading that way to eliminate that meet up.

title: Lumíria
overview: In the near future, three young people document the final days of their hometown, knowing they will never see it again.

title: To Kill a Nazi
overview: A documentary feature by award-winning filmmaker Boaz Dvir, “To Kill a Nazi” tells the story of a French family man who sets out in to kill his father’s Gestapo executioner and ended up playing a pivotal role in history’s most audacious hostage rescue.

title: Dead Files
overview: In the current University Palace of UFRJ (Federal University of Rio de Janeiro), echoes of a silenced past remain within its walls. Formerly Pedro II Asylum, the building holds the history of thousands of inmates from Brazil's first mental asylum. Through research using medical records and documents preserved at the university's Institute of Psychiatry, fragments of these lives are reconstructed with the words of a famous writer who was also interned there.

title: Wereshark
overview: A shark/werewolf hybrid begins hunting the residents of a seaside resort town, turning a summer getaway into a blood-soaked nightmare. A handful of locals must fight back together to stop the Wereshark before the entire town is devoured.

title: The Last Sunrise
overview: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.

title: The Dog Stars
overview: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.

title: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-ups
overview: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

title: Yellow Mirror
overview: A defective lamp reveals a heartbreaking truth about what Homer believes is reality, and an AI-powered tablet befriends and controls Maggie. The Simpsons struggle to find the light through two dark tales of the curious and bizarre.

title: Tad and The Magic Lamp
overview: Tadeo, his girlfriend Sara, and his friends Momia, Jeff, and Belzoni embark on an adventure after Tadeo accidentally unleashes an ancient spell.

title: The Penthouse
overview: The Penthouse" is a psychological thriller that follows Saina and David, a young family who moves into a luxurious penthouse in Kuala Lumpur to start a new life.

title: The Journey to Gyeong-ju
overview: Eight years ago, the youngest daughter, Gyeong-ju, disappeared during a school field trip to Gyeongju and never came home alive.  On what would have been her birthday, her mother Ok-sil and her three daughters—Jang-ju, Young-ju, and Dong-ju—put on matching family T-shirts and set off for Gyeongju, the place where Gyeong-ju vanished, in what appears to be a family trip to honor her memory. But beneath the cheerful façade lies a deadly secret. In the trunk of their van is a bound and unconscious man zipped inside a plastic bag.

title: The Unknown
overview: Photographer David Zimmerman rarely leaves home until friends bring him to a wild party. He becomes fixated on a mysterious woman and follows her. By dawn, his life transforms - he awakens in her body.

title: Memento Mori
overview: A young man looks back on the moment he first met his girlfriend, remembering the small sparks that brought them together. He tells their story with warmth and tenderness, from a simple encounter to a love that grew naturally between them. For him, it\s a cherished memory he still carries closely.

title: Dolly: An NBC News Special
overview: A look back at Dolly Parton's remarkable journey to stardom, her groundbreaking career and her lasting impact far beyond music.

title: Ang Pinakamasarap na Pares sa Balat ng Lupa
overview: Don and Mola are best friends who are always hungry, always together, and always messing things up. One day, Don finds out he’s sick and he has only 24 hours left to live.

title: Filipiñana
overview: While working at an elite country club outside Manila, a 17-year-old Ilocana worker uncovers the violent truths of her workplace, her country, and her own past after attempting to return a lost golf club to the club's president.

title: The Whisper Man
overview: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

title: Buddy
overview: A magical, singing orange unicorn holds his cast hostage in a surreal TV-show dimension, as he becomes more and more demented.

title: The Rope Curse 4: Kuntilanak
overview: A forbidden exorcism is livestreamed in Indonesia, awakening the legendary female spirit Kuntilanak. What begins as an online spectacle quickly turns deadly. In Taiwan, Mila watches the ritual—and becomes the curse’s first victim. Soon, mysterious deaths and violent possessions follow. When Yulan collapses and is found to have lost part of her soul, it becomes clear that this is not an isolated incident, but a transnational curse. Seeking answers, Mila’s son returns her ashes to Indonesia, hoping to uncover the truth behind her death. Instead, he steps into a nightmare rooted in ancient folklore and unresolved hatred. As supernatural violence escalates, the group realizes that once Kuntilanak is summoned, the curse will not stop—until it claims everything in its path.

title: Spider Island
overview: A group of social media influencers go to the launch of a new hotel on a tropical island, where they find deadly spiders.

title: Transpositions
overview: Simon Coutu explores the rise of transphobia and the weaponization of transgender identity in political and media discourse. Meeting with members of the trans community and with right-wing organizers who denounce what they call “gender ideology,” he seeks to understand how transgender identity has become such a polarizing issue in Québec.

title: Prosecution
overview: After surviving a racist attack, state prosecutor Seyo Kim takes her own case to court – confronting both the perpetrators and a justice system that turns a blind eye to right-wing extremism.

title: Solidarité Incendies - Le Grand Concert en direct
Listen, Mom
overview: A grieving playwright returns to his rural hometown to come out to his traditional mother following the sudden death of his partner. Their painful confrontation and the unspoken truths that come to light become the catalyst for him to find his creative voice again.

title: Operasi Pesta Copet
overview: In a desperate act to get quick money, Ijal and friends embark on a high-stakes operation: pickpocketing at Indonesia's biggest music festival, Pestapora.

title: April X
overview: When his twin sister April (Lilly Krug) goes missing, Bax (Connor Storrie) searches every corner of their futuristic, post-Soviet cityscape to find her. Ultimately descending into a violent criminal underworld and madness, Bax is forced to confront the cost of identity, love, and survival.

title: Chelot
overview: The story follows Haqqim, a special operations police officer, who is forced to become an informant for a crime syndicate to overcome financial pressure and save his family. This desperate act puts himself and his loved ones in danger.

title: Paket Santet
overview: A package arrives at their doorsteps. There is no sender's name. No explanation as to why it was delivered to them. But the moment they open it, their lives spiral into a nightmare. One by one, lives are put on the line. Now, the question is no longer how to avoid the package, but how to escape the curse once they have received it.

title: Shark Thrash
overview: A small and touristy beachside town is hit by a storm the size of which nobody could have predicted. A family who just arrived tries to escape, but gets stuck in the quickly rising waters. They try to figure a way out with the help of some locals, but any progress is shut down when the sharks make their way onto the flooded streets. The family and locals must now find a way to survive as the waters rise.

title: Muito Prazer
overview: Rubem, a rideshare driver with no prospects, receives as inheritance the Pérola Motel, which he soon discovers is a dilapidated building. There, he meets Grace, a former employee who had stayed on living in one of the suites after the motel closed. Unable to sell the property and mired in debt, Grace and Rubem join forces to reopen the motel. Almost as a lark and with the help of Nalva, an internet whiz, they begin recording their guests and, to make some extra cash, selling the videos with identities masked to erotic websites. The scheme quickly becomes both lucrative and dangerous.

title: Pa Pa Go
overview: Influencer Bunny struggles to stand out online when her ex-gangster father, Tian, is released from prison. Their reunion sparks conflict as he’s urged to rejoin the triad while she defends her career. Tian’s accidental viral fame fuels jealousy from his ambitious underling, triggering gang turmoil and exposing Bunny’s family ties. As her public image collapses, father and daughter must confront their past and choose between power, pride, and love—learning that redemption and understanding are the only way to truly move forward.

title: Rumah Singgah
overview: Karla, a talented young runner diagnosed with bone cancer, receives treatment at a halfway house. There, she learns to accept reality through the support of the residents and bu Andin, while together they realize their ultimate dream.

title: Our Secret
overview: A Black Brazilian family in the city of Belo Horizonte, tries to rebuild their home after a recent loss. Caught between memories and nightmares, and unable to express what they feel to each other, a mother and her children shield themselves from the pain of grief through their individual routines. Only the youngest child understands the secret that the house holds within its four walls and tries to reveal it to the others, only to fall on deaf ears. Finally, confronted with the truth, they face the deep roots of their grief and come together to traverse this moment with love and courage.

title: Poovellaam Kettuppaar
overview: A research project pulls Sathiya and Kartigeyan into the isolated world of Maaran and Nathiya. As the past meets the present, one conversation is all it takes to change their lives forever.

title: Moonzy: The Dark Side of the Moon
overview: Luntik, Kuzya and Vupsen and Pupsen build a spacecraft to find Luntik's missing dad and encounter adventures in the search.

title: Hive
overview: A strict, anxious teenager loses the child she’s babysitting and must brave a sinister force hiding in plain sight among the children in the playground. As her world unravels and her grip on reality starts to slip, she must outwit a world where nothing is as it seems to make it out alive.

title: Papi Ricky: La Película
overview: Alicia returns to Chile to introduce her future husband, an eccentric young Spanish hipster who embodies modernity. His arrival causes a family upheaval, and the clash with the conservative Papi Ricky and the irreverent Catrala leads both parents to put aside their old differences and unite around a common goal: stopping their daughter’s wedding.

title: Rotten
overview: A woman living with the pain of a rotten tooth plans to spend savings on a dentist appointment. But an unexpected afternoon with her boss's wife draws her into a world she cannot afford.

title: Trial of Hein
overview: After 14 years away, Hein returns to his home village on a remote island, only to discover that the close-knit community no longer recognises him. Suspecting him to be an impostor, they demand a trial to determine his true identity.

title: God Skin
overview: Win, takes a lethal gamble to fund his mother's medical treatment when Itt, an old friend, lures him into the Arena. In this brutal underground circuit, fighters are marked with "God Skin" tattoos to gain a ruthless edge.

title: Grin
overview: While visiting her family, Eva is introduced to her mother’s new partner, Lucian. When the group play Lucian’s mysterious old board game for the first time, they begin to believe it has summoned a demonic entity that punishes those who have committed terrible sins. After a series of terrifying encounters, the players begin going missing one by one. Eva soon realizes the game is more deadly than she could ever have imagined.

title: Sentient
overview: An investigation into laboratory research on animals exposes a hidden world in which it’s not just the animals getting hurt. The story of Dr. Lisa Jones Engel, a primatologist turned animal welfare advocate, asks whether harming animals and ourselves in science’s name is justified

title: Austerity
overview: Mona is a young woman and bookworm with no formal education, living in the social housing project Nøjsomheden in Helsingør. She falls head over heels in love with Nikolaj, who comes from a more well-off neighborhood on the other side of town. Meanwhile, she is also desperately trying to get her pusher cousin Frederik to realize that he must visit his dying mother, Mona's beloved and all-embracing Aunt Tut. Will Mona succeed in getting Frederik to reconcile with his mother - and how? Can she match the intellectual Nikolaj - or is the class gap too great?

title: Myth Schalke - A life long
overview: Mythos Schalke tells the story of the 2025/26 season, spanning the battle in the second division to FC Schalke 04's return to the Bundesliga.

title: Legend of the White Dragon
overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising-
overview: After the events of Rebellion, the world appears to be in balance—but that peace is fragile. As a new threat connected to Walpurgisnacht emerges, Homura Akemi is forced to face the consequences of her choices and question how far she is willing to go to protect Madoka.

title: Echo Point
overview: A man inherits a secluded cabin from his estranged father. Inside, he discovers an old radio emitting strange, eerie signals. As he begins to unravel the truth, he realises the voices on the other end belong to the victims of a killer.

title: The Secret Woman
overview: After discovering she has a family and a shipping empire, a woman with amnesia returns to a wealthy and seemingly perfect past to uncover why she left.

title: Hi!
overview: Two individuals initially exchange a simple "Hi," but through a series of chance encounters, shared experiences, and deep conversations, they gradually develop a strong connection and eventually fall in love.

title: Just Play Dead
overview: A criminal mastermind plans to fake his death for insurance money while framing his wife's lover. His wife plots to kill him for real and take it all. Both race to outmanoeuvre each other in a deadly battle of wits.

title: Barreda
overview: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

title: The Last Scene
overview: Selen is a woman with the extraordinary ability to foresee other people’s futures in her dreams. Determined to use this gift to change her own life and the fate of those around her, she unexpectedly finds herself drawn into a dangerous love story. When she crosses paths with Kemal, their connection sparks both passion and peril, forcing Selen to make choices that will shape both of their destinies.

title: Sex Drive
overview: Sheltered Sasha joins her uninhibited best friend Kelly on a getaway, but rescuing an amnesiac man turns their sexy escape into a deadly game of truth and deception.

title: Hideaway: The Dossiers
overview: A secret archive documenting the earliest revolutionary work of the Chinese Communist Party—the "Central Archives"—was successfully protected through the resilience and sacrifices of its guardians (both Party members and non-members) amid the turmoil and bloodshed from 1931 to 1949.

title: In Tania's Head
overview: Tania Head became a household name as a 9/11 survivor, celebrated for her miraculous escape from the very floor the plane hit. Her story of resilience, coupled with the heartbreaking death of her fiancé, Dave, moved the nation. As president of the Survivors' Network, she was a symbol of American strength, a fixture alongside political elites at Ground Zero. The illusion shattered in 2007 when a New York Times investigation proved her story was a lie: her career, her fiancé, even her identity.

title: Once More
overview: Raghu, a man caught up with a deep hold of grief comes across Anjali, who is spinning everything in her capacity to win him over. The love you gave away always comes back they say. In one way or other. Sometimes from a different human. This is a story of love coming back into the life of someone who doesn’t want to take it. A tale of second chances.. happy healing and bitter sweet closures.

title: Rise of the Footsoldier: Retribution
overview: Tate battles ruthless mercenaries throughout Ibiza as he avenges his friend's death.  Get ready for the biggest and most action packed film in the successful independent crime saga.

title: Boorman and the Devil
overview: Featuring commentary from surviving participants, as well as other filmmakers and critics, this documentary chronicles the career of director John Boorman and the tumultuous production of his film Exorcist II: The Heretic, exploring its critical and commercial failure, how it changed the industry, and the importance of risk-taking in art.

title: Babita Singh Reporting
overview: People-pleasing cop Baby accepts a fake charge to get leave for her sister-in-law’s baby shower in Rewa. There, she reunites with her childhood friend Bansi, who is murdered that very night. Defying dismissive in-laws, an indifferent husband and an apathetic local police force, she secretly investigates the murder, uncovering family betrayals while finding her own voice, courage and place as a real cop.

title: The Sun Never Sets
overview: Wendy’s life is thrown into chaos when her boyfriend, Jack, who is older and divorced with children, insists they take space to evaluate the relationship. During their break, Wendy runs into her ex, Chuck, forcing them into a volatile triangle.

title: The Ghost and The Gun
overview: In 1948 Malaya, WWII vets Iz and Abe face vengeful ex-ally Chin Liu, who betrayed them during the war and now leads terrorists to their village. Haunted by past trauma, Iz must confront both his demons and Chin Liu's deadly advance.

title: Corsu Mezu Mezu - Un soir au Vélodrome avec Patrick Fiori
Lust
overview: Professor Michael Meloun arrives in Belgrade as a visiting lecturer. He suffers a panic attack, and doctors find out his agoraphobia has worsened. He must stay indoors. Maria, whom he meets at the hospital, stays to care for him.

title: Beyond Belief
overview: An aspiring teenage rock star trains for a marathon after hearing a mysterious voice.

title: The Invisibles
overview: The story follows a family of five, living quietly and away from prying eyes on the Izu Islands—including the youngest daughter, born invisible. Their mother, who had raised her cheerfully, has passed away from illness, and their anxious father has devoted himself to hiding his daughters from the world. One day, however, they must set out on a journey to visit their grandmother, a famous actress living in Tokyo.

title: Kiku Chiranjeevi
overview: A young man named Chiru, born with dextrocardia-a rare condition where his heart is on the right side of his chest faces struggles and challenges as he works to overcome his condition and achieve his goals.

title: Castration Movie Chapter III. Junior Ghosts—Premorphic Drift; a fragmentary passage
overview: Izzy does everything in her power to stop her partner from transitioning.

title: Hamrawit 2026
overview: A film by Fuad Mustefa

title: Spying Stars
overview: Scientist Anandi visits Hanuman Island to perform the last rites ritual for her father. She is immediately placed in quarantine in a remote hotel due to a pandemic caused by a machine-dominant world. When a mysterious star starts following her, she escapes and seeks refuge with a mother and her transgender daughter.

title: Flaggan
overview: On election night 2010, two young Sweden Democrats — the charming but unserious Ville and his cousin Tobias — are given the task of hanging a huge Swedish flag in Rinkeby square, but end up drawn into a chaotic night full of crazy encounters with drug dealers, activists, and Finnish bikers.

title: Dead End
overview: Located in a futuristic Dhaka City from the 2100s. We follow Zayn Khan our protagonist, a genius engineer trying to fulfill his father's dream. However, he gets intertwined with a street racing gang named 'The Hawks', lead by Alvan Haque.

title: Top of the World
overview: Explores Windows on the World, the iconic restaurant that occupied the 106th and 107th floors of the North Tower of the World Trade Center.

title: Dress-Up
overview: A young couple, Charlie and Steph, both realize they're trans after having sex while wearing gender-swapped Halloween costumes. Charlie comes to terms with it faster than Steph, causing unexpected friction in their relationship.

title: The Brightest Sun
overview: When a private detective is murdered, a former colleague and a trainee detective are sent to investigate. Along the way, they uncover a tragic truth that triggers memories from their own haunted pasts.

title: Ebre / Trarza
overview: This short documentary addresses the global issue of climate change, highlighting its unequal impacts on rural communities in deltaic regions of both the Global South and North. While the Global North is a major contributor to climate change, its devastating effects are most felt in the Global South, particularly in regions like Trarza, Mauritania, where agriculture is severely impacted. Similarly, the Terres de l’Ebre in Catalonia faces rising sea levels and land erosion, threatening local livelihoods. These shared challenges provide a rich opportunity for youth from both regions to engage in dialogue and storytelling.

title: Juan Gabriel: Mi Primer Bellas Artes
overview: Mexico’s most iconic concert comes to U.S. theaters on September 15th, celebrating Mexican Independence Day and commemorating the 10th anniversary of Juan Gabriel’s passing. Experience his legendary first performance at Mexico City’s “Palacio de Bellas Artes” in 1990—a landmark event that forever transformed Mexican music. More than three decades later, this historic concert returns in a special theatrical release with newly restored picture and sound, plus an exclusive new opening featuring never-before-seen rehearsal footage from Juan Gabriel’s personal archive that offers a unique glimpse into the making of this unforgettable night. Every song, every standing ovation, and every iconic moment has been revitalized, allowing longtime fans and new audiences to experience this extraordinary performance like never before. Celebrate the timeless legacy of Juan Gabriel on the big screen in this once-in-a-generation cinematic event.

title: Call My Agent! The Movie
overview: Five years after ASK Agency closed, debut director Andréa loses her lead actor just days before filming and reunited with her old team — for better or worse.

title: The Bunt Video
overview: Starring Cephas Benson, Donovan Jones, James Hardy, JP Souza, Carlos Ribeiro, Jake Anderson, Jesse Alba, Dom Henry, Korahn Gayle, Morgan Smith, Sean Malto, Tanner Burzinski, Mitch Barrette and many more...

title: Dead Reset
overview: Trapped in an underwater research facility, surgeon Cole Mason is forced to operate on a mutating, parasitic creature. The catch? He’s trapped in a brutal, blood-soaked time loop and must relive his own violent demise over and over again. To survive, Cole must embrace death and find a way to kill the creature and stop the loop before he becomes trapped in a never ending spiral of horror.

title: Outflow
overview: A woman in emotional crisis embarks on an introspective journey in search of relief and transformation.

title: The Hoarder
overview: Medical student Melissa Knowles and her reluctant colleague Eric are making routine house calls to administer flu vaccines. When they step into Fred Hunt’s decaying, junk-crammed home, something immediately feels wrong. Fred seems like a harmless old recluse, but when Eric vanishes, Melissa’s search pulls her deeper into the house’s chaotic mess, revealing a labyrinth of tunnels carved through the piles of junk, twisting into suffocating darkness. And beneath it all, below the creaking floorboards, something stirs. Watching. Waiting.

title: RevPro 14 Year Anniversary Show
overview: Fourteen years of world-class action from Europe’s number one wrestling producers have led to this. On Saturday 29th August 2026, RevPro takes over the iconic OVO ARENA WEMBLEY for its biggest celebration yet—uniting the finest British and international talent for one unforgettable night. Expect championship clashes, dream matches, and the unmatched energy only RevPro fans bring.

title: Magic 8
overview: 1974. A Smoke filled Sports Bar. Love is like a game of pool. “Magic 8” is a 3 minute short film shot on Super 8, which explores what happens when making a queer connection in a stereotypically “Straight” space. It follows two men (referred to as Solid and Stripe), who engage in a game of 8-Ball Pool. As an audience we get the impression this is a regular occurrence for our two characters, but there is a mutual understanding that none of Solid’s inner dialogue could ever be said out loud.

title: 13 Souls
overview: Following her mother’s death, fifteen-year-old Agne moves in with her estranged father and older sister near a cemetery where he works. There, she uncovers a mysterious and deadly connection between her family and the “13 Souls” — victims of a tragic, unsolved fire decades earlier. As the past resurfaces and strange phenomena escalate, Agne finds herself entangled in a supernatural mystery tied to possession, reincarnation, and long-buried guilt.

title: Much About Love
overview: A TV director returns to her theater roots for a Shakespeare festival and runs into an old flame, rekindling a merry war of wits in this modern retelling of "Much Ado About Nothing."

title: Fire & Ice
overview: A musical western.

title: Will Revenge
overview: On what begins as a quiet night at home, four friends are confronted with the news of a devastating act of anti-trans violence. In an instant, their sense of safety is shattered. As shock gives way to grief—and grief to rage—their quiet evening fractures into a shared, unspoken question: what does justice look like when the world refuses to provide it?

title: Field Queens
overview: In rural Ireland, two fifteen-year-old girls clean vomit from a minibus after a drunken mishap the previous night. When they encounter the bus driver's elderly wife and spend the day with her drinking in a field, their friendship is put to the test unexpectedly.

title: Ithaqua
overview: During the decline of the fur trade, a mercenary struggles to unite the survivors of a famine-stricken outpost plagued by a dark force that leaves its victims with an insatiable hunger.

title: The Copycat Killer
overview: A traumatized criminal profiler is lured in to investigate a copycat killer mimicking her most infamous case while being framed as the prime suspect, or risk losing her freedom and becoming the next victim of a twisted game of revenge.

title: Dulce Violencia (aka Sweet Violence)
overview: A family plans to murder their daughter’s killer after he is released from a twenty-year prison sentence. Still pleading innocence, the ex-convict tries to rebuild his life until the ghosts of the past return to haunt him

title: Acouphène
overview: A young woman, haunted by persistent and unbearable tinnitus, gradually descends into madness. Driven to the brink, she begins to inflict increasingly serious injuries upon herself, hoping that the physical pain will drown out the sound that tortures her.

title: The Brook
overview: Moving to the village of his mother’s youth, art student Jacob discovers his grandad’s old video camera shows one hour into the past. In Elmbrook, a place steeped in strange folklore and whispered legends, the community believe their village is protected by a puma that watches over the “good.” But when one of the good locals mysteriously vanishes, Jacob and his friends, armed with the video camera, uncover clues that pull them deeper into Elmbrook’s bizarre secrets. Soon the search for answers spirals into a dangerous mystery as they uncover a vengeful serial killer with a connection to the past.

title: Oradour
overview: Five days before the massacre at Oradour-sur-Glane, Philippe Gerbier, an officer in the Free French Forces, is parachuted in near the village. He is to lead a mission for the Resistance in preparation for the D-Day landings. There, he is reunited with Marie, his childhood sweetheart.

title: AEW All In 2026: London
overview: All In 2026, also promoted as All In London, was a professional wrestling pay-per-view produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on August 30, 2026, at Wembley Stadium in London, England. The event featured AEW Men's and Women's World Championship matches earned by the winners of the 2026 Owen Hart Foundation Tournament.

title: Marloo
overview: An amateur theatre after-party leads to 26 charges being pressed. A man must confront his fragmented memories as he's pried and prodded for details of the night.

title: AAA Ola de Calor 2026
overview: Ola de Calor 2026 (Spanish for "Heat Wave") was a professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by Mexican professional wrestling promotion Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA) in partnership with its parent company WWE. The event took place on Sunday, August 30, 2026, at Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, United States - right before NXT Heatwave in the same venue.

title: NXT Heatwave 2026
overview: The 2026 NXT Heatwave was a professional wrestling television special and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It was the fifth annual Heatwave produced by WWE for its developmental brand NXT and the 12th Heatwave overall. The event took place on Sunday, August 30, 2026, at Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, United States - right after Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide's Ola de Calor event in the same venue.

title: Whale Shark Jack
overview: Sarah, 12, lives on a boat with her parents, who research whale sharks. Her only friend is a whale shark named Jack, who Sarah rescued when he was a pup. But following a tragic accident, mum and Sarah move to the coastal town of Exmouth. Desperate to return to her old life, Sarah pegs all her hopes on Jack, certain that when his migration brings him back to Exmouth, mum will take her out on the boat again. But Jack fails to return, so Sarah embarks on a risky mission to find him.

title: Why Religion?
overview: "Why Religion?" is a feature-length documentary film exploring the extraordinary work and personal journey of renowned scholar Elaine Pagels. Celebrated for her groundbreaking research on the Gnostic Gospels, Pagels challenges conventional religious narratives and invites us to rethink how early western religions approached divinity, enlightenment, and the human experience. The film offers intimate access to her life and work, revealing how her research of ancient texts shaped her own path of spirituality and self-discovery.

title: Plonternish
overview: Eli writes a play.

title: Inheritor
overview: On the day of her ascension within her secluded, tree-worshiping cult, Ama, a sheltered young woman, leaps into a treacherous psychedelic ritual that faces her with a choice between her duty to her people and her desire to be with her childhood best friend and lover, Oakley.

title: Zip Wire
overview: When her ground-breaking pharmaceutical discovery is stolen and partner murdered, researcher Amy must face her fear of heights to escape nefarious attackers, with the only path to salvation being a treacherous aerial runway. To outsmart the mysterious hostiles, she has to summon every ounce of courage to protect the world-changing scientific discovery — and herself — before it's too late.

title: Bloom
overview: When Lily inherits her great aunt's struggling desert nursery, she devotes herself to bringing it back to life. As her garden flourishes, her need to sustain it becomes something she can no longer control.

title: Bunny Rabbit
overview: In the aftermath of a climate apocalypse, a young woman roams the ruins of a world she never got to grow up in. Raised on scavenged books and b-movies, she lives alone in an old shack she once shared with her father. Supplies are scarce and food is running out. There’s nothing left to hunt. Nothing except other people...

title: Cockroaches
overview: Three porch pirates steal a van and find the kidnapped Queen of Belgium in the back. Low-rent larceny spirals into a disaster worth remembering and mutual regret might be mistaken for something deeper. Probably not, but maybe.

title: The Gambit
overview: Tony, a middle-aged man, is sitting at a table with a chessboard setup. Brent, in his early twenties, walks into the cafe and takes a seat across from Tony. They play a game of chess while they talk about business, through the lens of chess. Tony is clearly a veteran that has been playing a long time, and knows his way around the board. Brent is new to the game, but has a creativity and strategy that Tony can’t read.

title: LOOP
overview: In a near-future world where technology has rendered most human labor obsolete, Zoe Pearce, a despairing artist, finds herself selected as a finalist for the universe challenge. This exclusive competition promises membership in humanity's most coveted experience: complete digital personalized immersion, where pain, suffering, and unwanted emotions are eliminated.

title: Claire McKenna
overview: After years of addiction and isolation, Claire McKenna is finally home from rehab. It’s her first day back—and her first day of probation.  Anxiously awaiting her parole officer, Claire discovers something from her old life that suddenly puts her fragile new beginning into question.  To everyone around her, the moment may seem insignificant. For Claire, it’s a fierce and deeply personal battle to remain sober, honest, and alive.

title: Full Moon Rising: The Charles Band Story
overview: A brand new feature documentary about the incredible life and career of prolific film producer and director Charles Band.
